overall_goal: Incorporate tomato puree into the pan and cook the mixture

goals.description: Pour the tomato puree into the pan and mix it in
goals.rationale: The person pours the puree from the bowl, scrapes out the remainder, and begins mixing it into the pan.

goals.description: Cook and periodically stir the puree mixture
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly stirs the contents of the pan over time to ensure it cooks evenly and homogenizes.
